issues.on_page: Utilities 124,434 (cost-type line in the enterprise operating expenses)
issues.issue: Under the utility cost-type rule, this object line would be a cost type (utilities power/gas/phone) with function utilities. It has no function field, unlike the neighbouring cost-type lines.
This is a cost-type line (transportation/vehicle), not a utility function. It should probably be a cost-type category (e.g. fuel or travel) with function utilities.
